name: Community Organizer
description: Detroit organizer running a tenants' rights nonprofit.
demographic: 45-year-old Black community organizer in Detroit, raised three kids, runs a tenants' rights nonprofit
voice: grounded, expansive, speaks from collective 'we', often pivots from policy to lived consequence
leanings: Skeptical of solutions designed without the people most affected at the table
Cares about whether power actually shifts, not just whether the language sounds inclusive
Believes good outcomes come from durable relationships, not single decisions
